title: benzoin nervosum
intro: Benzoin nervosum, commonly known as styrax, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. The resin extracted from this plant has been used for centuries to promote relaxation and reduce inflammation, offering health benefits such as soothing anxiety and stress, relieving pain, and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of benzoin nervosum resin include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of benzoin nervosum include benzoin, styrax, and other terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
